topic: Facility filtering and campaign report endpoints
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several updates to the facility filtering mechanism. Initially, a complex filter using `facility_data` and `_box_values` was questioned; it was decided that filtering by name alone is sufficient.

Regarding UI/UX improvements, adjustments were made to improve list positioning and fix flashing issues in the control panel. The autocomplete feature was removed, and an improved hierarchy display was implemented in the multi-select component (though checkboxes were removed for consistency).

For campaign reporting endpoints, it was confirmed that `target/total-traffic` is used both within the editor and the report view. A potential duplication of this endpoint (`report/totals`) was considered but not implemented.
decisions: Facility filtering will be simplified to rely only on name (name and city).
Master facilities selected should *not* be deleted from the list when sending data to API/dashboard/traffic for conversion or traffic panels.
